name: epo
description: Epo — a reliable, safe, observable Instagram growth engine built on a local event-sourced knowledge graph.

scripts.start: npm run fix:electron && npm run build && node scripts/run-desktop.mjs
scripts.dev: npm run fix:electron && npm run build:dev && node scripts/run-desktop.mjs
scripts.capture: npm run fix:electron && npm run build && electron dist/capture/capture-main.js
scripts.livetest: npm run fix:electron && npm run build && electron dist/livetest/livetest-main.js
scripts.inspect: npm run fix:electron && npm run build && electron dist/inspect/inspect-main.js
scripts.probe: npm run fix:electron && npm run build && electron dist/probe/probe-main.js
scripts.check: npm run gen:targets:check && npm run gen:tokens:check && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run boundaries && npm run build:page:check && npm test && npm run build:dev
scripts.surface: npm run fix:electron && npm run build && electron dist/surface-lab/main.js
